title: Moderator
body:
Any proposal that gains a majority in a vote immediately becomes law. If no proposals are approved by the end of meeting time, you will be expelled from the city.

You were randomly selected to moderate the conversation, make sure everyone has a chance to talk, draft proposals and call for votes.
